title: Developing a UFO flight simulator playable in your browser
author: BotLordBotflix
selftext:
Made this with Codex and a lifelong fascination with flying saucers. Behold! UFO Flight Simulator, a free-roaming 3D experience built around one simple idea: flying a UFO should be fun.

Hover effortlessly, accelerate to insane speeds, pull off impossible maneuvers, and explore the world with a flying saucer. No abductions, missions, or complicated objectives. Just pure flight.

Runs in your browser. Nothing to install, login to or download. 

It's a first draft so tell me what you'd add to make it better. Hope you enjoy!

[https://ufoflightsimulator.com](https://ufoflightsimulator.com)
